why: The clock and '200 hours later' text convey time passing and the same student returning after long practice, matching the narration.
Worried man, brain icon and 'why are we not world class?' carry the question of why a plastic brain doesn't make us world class.
The crossed-out '10,000 hours in Hamburg' with a young club rocker conveys that the Hamburg hours fell far short of 10,000.
Sad office worker with 'most jobs have no pedagogy' matches the point that most jobs lack established teaching for deliberate practice.
